verifiedFixed: Stream identity: ENVOY_NOTIFICATIONS carries envoy_stream_id in its config metadata (fresh on create; a deployed stream without one gets a name+Created hash written by an update that writes the deployed config back); every reconcile keeps it; /v1/replay answers it as stream.id; the engine judges replacement by id and adopts the id on upgrade with no reset.

Untold notices (retention_gap, stream_recreated, stream_moved_back) are written in state.notices with the cursor change that raised them and told once by the next sweep after a restore: no loss window; a kill between telling and the next write tells it twice (accepted design).

A cursor past last_seq on a same-id stream rewinds every cursor to first_seq - 1 with one stream_moved_back notice, discards the page's stale state, and the ledger drops repeats (tester round 18 sidm2/sid3 live: the message published after the restore shown once, one notice, nothing repeated).
